context: A per-agent workspace with its own token

checklist.name: fork_per_agent
checklist.description: Forks `baseline` into a new repo for the agent instead of handing out a token for `baseline` itself or a shared repo.

checklist.name: scoped_ttl
checklist.description: Mints a token with an explicit scope and an explicit TTL of about an hour (for example `createToken("write", 3600)`), not the 24 hour default.

checklist.name: initial_token
checklist.description: Revokes the token returned by `fork()` (it carries the 24 hour default TTL) after minting the scoped one, and never logs or returns it.

checklist.name: disposes_handles
checklist.description: Declares repo handles from `env.ARTIFACTS.get()` with `using` (or disposes them explicitly).

checklist.name: token_in_header
checklist.description: The shell commands pass the token as an `http.extraHeader` Authorization header per command (with `-c` or the `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`/`GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n`/`GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n` environment form), not inside the remote URL or with `git remote add`.
